walkthroughs.body_html:
England 1547-1603: The Later Tudors — a core area of A-Level History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

England 1547-1603: The Later Tudors brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with England 1547-1603: The Later Tudors.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which 1533 Act prevented appeals to Rome?
options: Act of Supremacy
Act of Appeals
Act of Uniformity
Act of Succession

mcqs.q: Who controlled the Council Learned under Henry VII?
options: Wolsey and More
Empson and Dudley
Cromwell and Cranmer
Morton and Bray

mcqs.q: What were the Wars of the Roses really about?
options: They were a religious war between Catholics and Protestants.
The whole country was at war for thirty continuous years.
It was a battle in which the SA tried to overthrow Hitler.
Dynastic conflict between rival branches of the Plantagenets (Lancaster and York) over the throne, intensified by weak kingship under Henry VI and noble factionalism.

mcqs.q: Why did Hitler order the Night of the Long Knives in 1934?
options: Hitler purged the SA because they were Communists.
It was a battle in which the SA tried to overthrow Hitler.
To eliminate Ernst Röhm and the SA leadership, reassure the army of his authority, and remove rivals — securing the army's loyalty when Hindenburg died weeks later.
Jews were expelled because they refused to fight in the Crusades.

mcqs.q: Why were Jews expelled from England in 1290?
options: Jews left England voluntarily because they were no longer welcome.
Jews were expelled because they refused to fight in the Crusades.
Edward I expelled Jews after a century of restrictions and taxation had impoverished the community; antisemitism, debts owed to Jews, and political pressure all contributed.
It was a battle in which the SA tried to overthrow Hitler.
